root_causes.RC1-SINGLE-LEDGER: One value (totalCapAllocations) is substituted for Team Salary, Apron Team Salary, Tax Team Salary and taxablePayroll. computeTeamCapTotals.ts:274-286 + createCanonicalTeamTotalsSnapshot:342-355.
root_causes.RC2-NO-APRON-LEDGER: No Apron Team Salary ledger exists; all apron tests read pre-trade/among-total Team Salary. Consequence of RC1.
root_causes.RC3-NO-TAX-ENGINE: No tax bracket/rate/repeater computation anywhere; taxBill/taxRate are optional passthrough schema fields only (schemas/architect.ts:258-259).
root_causes.RC4-PATHLESS-MATCHING: Salary matching is one apron-status band ceiling, not five named TPE paths with structures, exclusivity and per-path availability. salaryMatchingRules.ts:223-321.
root_causes.RC5-TXN-TABLE-3-OF-11: Only 3 of 11 Transaction Restrictions Table rows trigger a hard cap, and no row ever triggers a Second Apron hard cap. hardCapUtils.ts:38-49.
root_causes.RC6-STALE-HARDCODED-PARAMS: Season-varying CBA amounts hardcoded to a single season and not derived from capRulesProfile: EXPANDED_TPE 9_096_000 (salaryMatchingRules.ts:81), SEASONAL_CASH_LIMIT 5_800_000 (validateCash.ts:13), ROOKIE_SCALE + MINIMUM_SALARY_BY_YOS 2024-25 (capHolds.ts:155-203).
root_causes.RC7-MISSING-RUNTIME-INPUT: Rules deliberately not enforced because the payload lacks the field (acquisition date, protection state, earned-to-date compensation, prior-team performance). timingValidation.ts:66-68,259-260.
root_causes.RC8-NO-BONUS-MODEL: No Likely/Unlikely performance-bonus or signing-bonus representation exists; only a scalar tradeBonus. Negative search: performanceBonus/signingBonus = 0 hits in src/features/architect.
root_causes.RC9-NO-CLAIM-LIFECYCLE: Waiver is modelled as immediate release; no claim, priority, clearance, or financial-responsibility lifecycle. Negative search: waiverClaim/claimPriority/clearWaivers = 0 hits.
root_causes.RC10-DUP-CONSTANT-SOURCES: Competing constant tables for the same governed values (CBA_THRESHOLDS vs capProjections; capHolds ROOKIE_SCALE vs minimumSalaryRules), reachable via different call paths.
root_causes.RC11-NO-EXTERNAL-DETERMINATION-MODEL: No authenticated external-determination record (medical, expert, grievance, league approval) with provenance.
root_causes.RC12-NO-LIST-MODEL: No Active/Inactive/Two-Way list model, day clocks, or game-count accounting; roster is a flat player array with a standard/two-way split.
root_causes.RC13-FLAGGED-ENFORCEMENT: Whole rule families can be downgraded to warn or off by config (validationFlags.timingEnforcement, shouldWarnOnly('salaryMatching')).

CBA2-A01.1.group_title: Independent transaction-salary bases — Are the CBA's distinct salary quantities derived independently for the same player, team, and date?
CBA2-A01.1.requirement: Team Salary, Apron Team Salary, Tax-related Team Salary, player Compensation, and per-team trade-salary values (pre-trade and post-assignment Salaries) are distinct defined quantities; no ledger's value may be substituted for another's — each must be derived from its own definitional rule for the given team, player, and date
CBA2-A01.1.basis: A single derived quantity is reused as Team, Apron and Tax salary; the non-substitution rule is violated at the source.

CBA2-A02.1.group_title: Traded Player Exception paths — Are the Standard, Aggregated, Transition, Expanded, and room acquisition paths enforced with their exact structures, limits, and exclusions?
CBA2-A02.1.requirement: Standard TPE structure: the Standard Traded Player Exception replaces exactly one Traded Player with one or more Replacement Players, whose Contracts may be acquired simultaneously or non-simultaneously
CBA2-A02.1.basis: Ceiling arithmetic is right for the common over-cap case; the five named paths, their structures and their exclusivity are not modelled.

CBA2-A02.2.group_title: Traded Player Exception paths — Are the Standard, Aggregated, Transition, Expanded, and room acquisition paths enforced with their exact structures, limits, and exclusions?
CBA2-A02.2.requirement: Standard TPE limit: the Replacement Players' post-assignment Salaries for the Salary Cap Year of acquisition may not, in aggregate, exceed 100% of the Traded Player's pre-trade Salary plus the $250,000 allowance as governed by CBA2-A02.12
CBA2-A02.2.basis: Ceiling arithmetic is right for the common over-cap case; the five named paths, their structures and their exclusivity are not modelled.

CBA2-A02.3.requirement: Standard TPE non-simultaneous window: any Replacement Player Contract acquired non-simultaneously under the Standard TPE must be acquired within one year following the date the Traded Player was traded
CBA2-A02.3.basis: Ceiling arithmetic is right for the common over-cap case; the five named paths, their structures and their exclusivity are not modelled.

CBA2-A02.4.group_title: Traded Player Exception paths — Are the Standard, Aggregated, Transition, Expanded, and room acquisition paths enforced with their exact structures, limits, and exclusions?
CBA2-A02.4.requirement: Aggregated TPE structure: the Aggregated Standard Traded Player Exception replaces two or more Traded Players with one or more Replacement Players whose Contracts are acquired simultaneously only

CBA2-A02.5.group_title: Traded Player Exception paths — Are the Standard, Aggregated, Transition, Expanded, and room acquisition paths enforced with their exact structures, limits, and exclusions?
CBA2-A02.5.requirement: Aggregated TPE limit: the Replacement Players' post-trade Salaries for the then-current Salary Cap Year may not, in aggregate, exceed 100% of the aggregated pre-trade Salaries of the Traded Players plus the $250,000 allowance as governed by CBA2-A02.12
CBA2-A02.5.basis: Ceiling arithmetic is right for the common over-cap case; the five named paths, their structures and their exclusivity are not modelled.

CBA2-A02.6.group_title: Traded Player Exception paths — Are the Standard, Aggregated, Transition, Expanded, and room acquisition paths enforced with their exact structures, limits, and exclusions?

CBA2-A02.6.basis: No Transition TPE exists in either direction (zero hits), so the 2023-24-only boundary is trivially not violated but also not represented. Historical-simulation scope only.

CBA2-A02.7.group_title: Traded Player Exception paths — Are the Standard, Aggregated, Transition, Expanded, and room acquisition paths enforced with their exact structures, limits, and exclusions?
CBA2-A02.7.requirement: Expanded TPE structure: the Expanded Traded Player Exception replaces one or more Traded Players with one or more Replacement Players whose Contracts are acquired simultaneously
CBA2-A02.7.basis: Ceiling arithmetic is right for the common over-cap case; the five named paths, their structures and their exclusivity are not modelled.

CBA2-A02.8.group_title: Traded Player Exception paths — Are the Standard, Aggregated, Transition, Expanded, and room acquisition paths enforced with their exact structures, limits, and exclusions?
CBA2-A02.8.requirement: Expanded TPE limit: the Replacement Players' aggregate post-trade Salaries for the then-current Salary Cap Year may not exceed max(min(200% × O + K, 100% × O + A), 125% × O + K), where O is aggregated pre-trade Salary, K is the CBA2-A02.12 allowance, and A = $7,500,000 × (current Salary Cap ÷ 2023-24 Salary Cap)
CBA2-A02.8.basis: The piecewise band function in salaryMatchingRules.ts:156-217 is algebraically identical to max(min(200%O+K,100%O+A),125%O+K). The defect is the input: A is the literal 9_096_000, ~$290 above the Canon-derived 7.5M x (164,961,000/136,021,000) and unchanged in every other season. Calculation is right; the season-scaled input is not.

CBA2-A02.9.group_title: Traded Player Exception paths — Are the Standard, Aggregated, Transition, Expanded, and room acquisition paths enforced with their exact structures, limits, and exclusions?
CBA2-A02.9.requirement: Room path limit: a Team with a Team Salary below the Salary Cap may acquire one or more players by assignment whose aggregate post-assignment Salaries do not exceed the Team's room under the Salary Cap plus $250,000 (allowance governed by CBA2-A02.12)
CBA2-A02.9.basis: The under-cap branch (validateSalaryMatching.ts:464-481) checks net addition against remaining room, which approximates the room path, but omits the $250,000 allowance.

CBA2-A02.10.group_title: Traded Player Exception paths — Are the Standard, Aggregated, Transition, Expanded, and room acquisition paths enforced with their exact structures, limits, and exclusions?
CBA2-A02.10.requirement: Room-path exclusivity: a Team that acquires players under VII §6(j)(1)(v) or with room under the Salary Cap may not simultaneously acquire any player under VII §6(j)(1)(i)-(iv)
CBA2-A02.10.basis: No room-path exclusivity test: zero hits for roomPath/ROOM_PATH/roomExclusiv across src.

CBA2-A02.11.group_title: Traded Player Exception paths — Are the Standard, Aggregated, Transition, Expanded, and room acquisition paths enforced with their exact structures, limits, and exclusions?
CBA2-A02.11.requirement: Below-cap election: in lieu of the room path, a Team with a Team Salary below the Salary Cap may conduct a trade in accordance with VII §6(j)(1)(iii)-(iv), notwithstanding VII §6(n)
CBA2-A02.11.basis: A below-cap team is routed unconditionally to outgoing+capSpace and can never elect the (iii)/(iv) paths, so a legal below-cap Expanded-path trade is false-blocked.

CBA2-A02.12.group_title: Traded Player Exception paths — Are the Standard, Aggregated, Transition, Expanded, and room acquisition paths enforced with their exact structures, limits, and exclusions?
CBA2-A02.12.requirement: $250,000 allowance zeroing: if a Team's post-assignment Apron Team Salary would exceed the First Apron Level, the $250,000 allowance referenced in each of VII §6(j)(1)(i)-(v) is reduced to $0
CBA2-A02.12.basis: The $250k allowance is zeroed only as a side effect of the pre-trade first-apron branch; the rule requires post-assignment Apron Team Salary, which does not exist.

CBA2-A02.13.group_title: Traded Player Exception paths — Are the Standard, Aggregated, Transition, Expanded, and room acquisition paths enforced with their exact structures, limits, and exclusions?

CBA2-A02.13.basis: No DPE-disabled-player TPE exclusion; DPE exists only as an exception label.

CBA2-A02.14.group_title: Traded Player Exception paths — Are the Standard, Aggregated, Transition, Expanded, and room acquisition paths enforced with their exact structures, limits, and exclusions?

CBA2-A02.14.basis: Two-way contracts carry a zero cap hit (contractUtils.ts:447-449), which removes them from the arithmetic, but no explicit rule excludes them from TPE creation or Replacement Player calculations.

CBA2-A07.3.group_title: Sign-and-trade conditions — Is every VII §8(e)(1) sign-and-trade condition independently enforced?

CBA2-A07.4.group_title: Sign-and-trade conditions — Is every VII §8(e)(1) sign-and-trade condition independently enforced?
CBA2-A07.4.requirement: Sign-and-trade first-season protection: the first Season of the Contract must be fully protected for lack of skill (VII §8(e)(1)(iv))
CBA2-A07.4.basis: validateSignAndTrade.ts exists and covers timing plus the first-apron consequence; most §8(e)(1) preconditions are not independently enforced.

CBA2-A07.5.group_title: Sign-and-trade conditions — Is every VII §8(e)(1) sign-and-trade condition independently enforced?
CBA2-A07.5.requirement: Sign-and-trade exception bar: the Contract may not be signed pursuant to the Non-Taxpayer Mid-Level Salary Exception or the Mid-Level Salary Exception for Room Teams (VII §8(e)(1)(iii))

CBA2-A07.6.group_title: Sign-and-trade conditions — Is every VII §8(e)(1) sign-and-trade condition independently enforced?

CBA2-A07.7.group_title: Sign-and-trade conditions — Is every VII §8(e)(1) sign-and-trade condition independently enforced?
CBA2-A07.7.requirement: Sign-and-trade Higher Max limit: for a 5th Year Eligible Player who met a Higher Max Criterion, the Contract may not provide first-season Salary plus Unlikely Bonuses above 25% of the Salary Cap as calculated per Article II §7 (VII §8(e)(1)(vi))
CBA2-A07.7.basis: validateSignAndTrade.ts exists and covers timing plus the first-apron consequence; most §8(e)(1) preconditions are not independently enforced.

CBA2-A07.8.group_title: Sign-and-trade conditions — Is every VII §8(e)(1) sign-and-trade condition independently enforced?
CBA2-A07.8.requirement: Sign-and-trade acquisition authority: the acquiring Team must have Room — room under the Salary Cap or entitlement to use a qualifying Exception per Article I §1(kkk) — for the player's Salary plus any first-season Unlikely Bonuses (VII §8(e)(1)(vii))
CBA2-A07.8.basis: validateSignAndTrade.ts exists and covers timing plus the first-apron consequence; most §8(e)(1) preconditions are not independently enforced.

CBA2-A07.9.group_title: Sign-and-trade conditions — Is every VII §8(e)(1) sign-and-trade condition independently enforced?
CBA2-A07.9.requirement: Exhibit 6 bar: a Player Contract or Extension entered into under VII §8(e)(1) or (2) may not contain an Exhibit 6
CBA2-A07.9.basis: validateSignAndTrade.ts exists and covers timing plus the first-apron consequence; most §8(e)(1) preconditions are not independently enforced.

CBA2-A07.10.group_title: Sign-and-trade conditions — Is every VII §8(e)(1) sign-and-trade condition independently enforced?
CBA2-A07.10.requirement: Prescribed physical-exam condition: although an Exhibit 6 is barred, the Teams may agree that a sign-and-trade or extension-and-trade is conditional on the player's passage of a physical examination performed by a physician designated by the assignee Team in accordance with NBA procedures
CBA2-A07.10.basis: validateSignAndTrade.ts exists and covers timing plus the first-apron consequence; most §8(e)(1) preconditions are not independently enforced.

CBA2-A08.1.group_title: Cash in trades — Are the separate annual cash limits, the signing-bonus-as-cash rule, the Salary-Cap-Year charging rule, and the no-Team-Salary-effect rule enforced?
CBA2-A08.1.requirement: Cash-paid annual limit: a Team may pay, directly or indirectly, no more than 5.15% of the Salary Cap in connection with trades in one Salary Cap Year
CBA2-A08.1.basis: validateCash.ts:13 uses a flat SEASONAL_CASH_LIMIT of $5,800,000 where the rule is 5.15% of the Salary Cap ($8,495,491 at the 2026-27 cap of $164,961,000) — the limit is ~$2.7M too tight and not season-scaled.

CBA2-A08.2.group_title: Cash in trades — Are the separate annual cash limits, the signing-bonus-as-cash rule, the Salary-Cap-Year charging rule, and the no-Team-Salary-effect rule enforced?
CBA2-A08.2.requirement: Cash-received annual limit: a Team may receive, directly or indirectly, no more than 5.15% of the Salary Cap in connection with trades in one Salary Cap Year, including reimbursement of Compensation obligations for acquired players
CBA2-A08.2.basis: Only team.cashLedger.totalOut is read; there is no cash-received ledger or limit.

CBA2-A08.3.group_title: Cash in trades — Are the separate annual cash limits, the signing-bonus-as-cash rule, the Salary-Cap-Year charging rule, and the no-Team-Salary-effect rule enforced?
CBA2-A08.3.requirement: Signing bonus as cash: when a Contract signed and traded under VII §8(e)(1) contains a signing bonus, the signing Team's payment of any portion of that bonus is treated as reimbursement of the assignee's Compensation obligation and counts against the VII §8(a) cash limits
CBA2-A08.3.basis: Cash-paid limit is a stale flat $5.8M rather than 5.15% of the Salary Cap; cash received is not tracked at all.

CBA2-A08.4.group_title: Cash in trades — Are the separate annual cash limits, the signing-bonus-as-cash rule, the Salary-Cap-Year charging rule, and the no-Team-Salary-effect rule enforced?
CBA2-A08.4.requirement: Cash-in-trade Salary-Cap-Year charging: each cash payment or receipt regulated by VII §8(a) is charged against the applicable limit for the Salary Cap Year in which the trade occurs
CBA2-A08.4.basis: Cash-paid limit is a stale flat $5.8M rather than 5.15% of the Salary Cap; cash received is not tracked at all.

CBA2-A08.5.group_title: Cash in trades — Are the separate annual cash limits, the signing-bonus-as-cash rule, the Salary-Cap-Year charging rule, and the no-Team-Salary-effect rule enforced?
CBA2-A08.5.requirement: No Team Salary effect: cash paid or received in connection with a trade is inter-team consideration outside the VII §4(a) Team Salary computation and never enters Team Salary
CBA2-A08.5.basis: Cash never enters computeTeamCapTotals; the exclusion holds by construction, verified by the closed input list at computeTeamCapTotals.ts:274-279.

CBA2-A08.6.group_title: Cash in trades — Are the separate annual cash limits, the signing-bonus-as-cash rule, the Salary-Cap-Year charging rule, and the no-Team-Salary-effect rule enforced?
CBA2-A08.6.requirement: No-netting: cash paid and cash received under VII §8(a) are tracked against separate annual limits and may not be netted against one another
CBA2-A08.6.basis: No-netting cannot be satisfied while only one direction is tracked.

CBA2-A08.7.group_title: Cash in trades — Are the separate annual cash limits, the signing-bonus-as-cash rule, the Salary-Cap-Year charging rule, and the no-Team-Salary-effect rule enforced?
CBA2-A08.7.requirement: Conditional cash trade-year application: cash payable only if a trade condition later occurs is attributed to the Salary Cap Year of the underlying trade for applying the separate §8(a) cash limits
CBA2-A08.7.basis: Cash-paid limit is a stale flat $5.8M rather than 5.15% of the Salary Cap; cash received is not tracked at all.

CBA2-A09.1.group_title: Roster room at trade — Is the BYL 4.05(e) list-room requirement enforced at the Trade Call?
CBA2-A09.1.requirement: Trade Call list room: the league will not conduct a Trade Call unless each party has room on its Active List, Inactive List, or Two-Way List (or will have room once the Trade Call is completed) for every player it receives in the transaction — a planned post-trade waiver does not satisfy the requirement
CBA2-A09.1.basis: validateRoster.ts enforces a 15-man standard bound but not BYL 4.05(e) Active/Inactive/Two-Way list room at the Trade Call.

CBA2-A10.1.group_title: Extension-and-trade — Are the VII §8(e)(2) mechanism, window, term, salary, raise, ordinary-extension eligibility, and six-month restrictions enforced?
CBA2-A10.1.requirement: Extension-and-trade mechanism: a player and Team may amend a Contract by entering into an Extension (never a Renegotiation) pursuant to an agreement between that Team and another Team concerning the signing of the amendment and the subsequent trade of the amended Contract (VII §8(e)(2))
CBA2-A10.1.basis: Extension validation covers years/first-year-max/raises only; no §8(e)(2) extend-and-trade branch and no §7(a) eligibility/anniversary/timing rules.

CBA2-A10.2.group_title: Extension-and-trade — Are the VII §8(e)(2) mechanism, window, term, salary, raise, ordinary-extension eligibility, and six-month restrictions enforced?
CBA2-A10.2.requirement: Extension-and-trade window bar: no VII §8(e)(2) agreement may be made from the last day of the last Regular Season covered by the Contract (or of any Regular Season that could be its last based on Option/ETO exercise or non-exercise) through the following June 30
CBA2-A10.2.basis: Extension validation covers years/first-year-max/raises only; no §8(e)(2) extend-and-trade branch and no §7(a) eligibility/anniversary/timing rules.

CBA2-A10.3.group_title: Extension-and-trade — Are the VII §8(e)(2) mechanism, window, term, salary, raise, ordinary-extension eligibility, and six-month restrictions enforced?
CBA2-A10.3.requirement: Extension-and-trade term limit: an Extension entered into under VII §8(e)(2) on or after the first day of the 2024-25 Salary Cap Year may cover no more than four Seasons from the date it is signed (three Seasons for earlier signings)
CBA2-A10.3.basis: Extension validation covers years/first-year-max/raises only; no §8(e)(2) extend-and-trade branch and no §7(a) eligibility/anniversary/timing rules.

CBA2-A10.4.group_title: Extension-and-trade — Are the VII §8(e)(2) mechanism, window, term, salary, raise, ordinary-extension eligibility, and six-month restrictions enforced?
CBA2-A10.4.requirement: On/after-2024-25 first-year Salary ceiling: for a VII §8(e)(2) Extension signed on or after the first day of the 2024-25 Salary Cap Year, first extended-term Salary excluding Incentive Compensation may not exceed the greater of 120% of last-original-term Regular Salary and 120% of EAPS less first-year Incentive Compensation, if any
CBA2-A10.4.basis: Extension validation covers years/first-year-max/raises only; no §8(e)(2) extend-and-trade branch and no §7(a) eligibility/anniversary/timing rules.

CBA2-A10.5.group_title: Extension-and-trade — Are the VII §8(e)(2) mechanism, window, term, salary, raise, ordinary-extension eligibility, and six-month restrictions enforced?
CBA2-A10.5.requirement: Extension annual Salary change limit: after the first extended-term year, Salary excluding Incentive Compensation may increase or decrease relative to the prior year's corresponding Salary by no more than 5% of the Salary excluding Incentive Compensation in the first extended-term year
CBA2-A10.5.basis: Extension validation covers years/first-year-max/raises only; no §8(e)(2) extend-and-trade branch and no §7(a) eligibility/anniversary/timing rules.

CBA2-A10.6.group_title: Extension-and-trade — Are the VII §8(e)(2) mechanism, window, term, salary, raise, ordinary-extension eligibility, and six-month restrictions enforced?
CBA2-A10.6.requirement: Three- or four-Season Contract anniversary: a non-Rookie Scale Contract covering three or four Seasons, including Option Years, may be extended no sooner than the second anniversary of its signing or most recent Extension, as determined under CBA2-A10.26 and A10.27
CBA2-A10.6.basis: Extension validation covers years/first-year-max/raises only; no §8(e)(2) extend-and-trade branch and no §7(a) eligibility/anniversary/timing rules.

CBA2-A10.7.group_title: Extension-and-trade — Are the VII §8(e)(2) mechanism, window, term, salary, raise, ordinary-extension eligibility, and six-month restrictions enforced?
CBA2-A10.7.requirement: Post-amendment trade bar: a player who enters into a VII §7(a) Extension covering five Seasons or exceeding the VII §8(e)(2) salary/raise limits (four or more Seasons for pre-2024-25 signings), or any VII §7(c) Renegotiation, may not be traded for six months after the signing
CBA2-A10.7.basis: Extension validation covers years/first-year-max/raises only; no §8(e)(2) extend-and-trade branch and no §7(a) eligibility/anniversary/timing rules.

CBA2-A10.8.group_title: Extension-and-trade — Are the VII §8(e)(2) mechanism, window, term, salary, raise, ordinary-extension eligibility, and six-month restrictions enforced?
CBA2-A10.8.requirement: Post-trade amendment bar: for six months after acquiring a player by trade, the acquiring Team may not enter into a VII §7(a) Extension covering five Seasons or exceeding the VII §8(e)(2)-permissible salary/raise amounts as of the trade date (four or more Seasons for pre-2024-25 trades), or any VII §7(c) Renegotiation, with that player
CBA2-A10.8.basis: Extension validation covers years/first-year-max/raises only; no §8(e)(2) extend-and-trade branch and no §7(a) eligibility/anniversary/timing rules.

CBA2-A10.9.requirement: On/after-2024-25 first-year Likely Bonus ceiling: when CBA2-A10.17 is satisfied for a VII §8(e)(2) Extension signed on or after the first day of the 2024-25 Salary Cap Year, first-extended-year Likely Bonuses may not exceed 120% of the Likely Bonuses in the last original-term Salary Cap Year
CBA2-A10.9.basis: Extension validation covers years/first-year-max/raises only; no §8(e)(2) extend-and-trade branch and no §7(a) eligibility/anniversary/timing rules.

CBA2-A10.10.requirement: Extension annual Regular Salary change limit: after the first extended-term year, Regular Salary may increase or decrease relative to the prior year's Regular Salary by no more than 5% of Regular Salary in the first extended-term year
CBA2-A10.10.basis: Extension validation covers years/first-year-max/raises only; no §8(e)(2) extend-and-trade branch and no §7(a) eligibility/anniversary/timing rules.

CBA2-A10.11.requirement: Per-bonus annual amount-change limit: after the first extended-term year, each individual Performance Bonus may increase or decrease by no more than 5% of that bonus's amount in the first extended-term year
CBA2-A10.11.basis: Extension validation covers years/first-year-max/raises only; no §8(e)(2) extend-and-trade branch and no §7(a) eligibility/anniversary/timing rules.

CBA2-A10.12.requirement: More-than-ten-percent renegotiation anniversary: when a Contract was renegotiated to increase Salary in any covered Salary Cap Year by more than 10% of pre-renegotiation Salary, it may not subsequently be extended until the third anniversary of that Renegotiation
CBA2-A10.12.basis: Extension validation covers years/first-year-max/raises only; no §8(e)(2) extend-and-trade branch and no §7(a) eligibility/anniversary/timing rules.

CBA2-A10.13.requirement: ETO-shortened-term bar: a Contract whose term was shortened through exercise of an Early Termination Option may not be extended under VII §7(a)
CBA2-A10.13.basis: Extension validation covers years/first-year-max/raises only; no §8(e)(2) extend-and-trade branch and no §7(a) eligibility/anniversary/timing rules.

CBA2-A10.14.requirement: Exercised-Option extension permission: subject to the other VII §7(a) rules, a Contract may be extended after the player or Team exercises an Option

CBA2-A10.15.requirement: QVFA-at-conclusion condition: a player who will not be a Qualifying Veteran Free Agent when his Contract concludes is not eligible to enter an Extension under VII §7(a)
CBA2-A10.15.basis: Extension validation covers years/first-year-max/raises only; no §8(e)(2) extend-and-trade branch and no §7(a) eligibility/anniversary/timing rules.

CBA2-A10.16.requirement: Pre-2024-25 first-year Salary ceiling: for a VII §8(e)(2) Extension signed before the first day of the 2024-25 Salary Cap Year, first extended-term Salary excluding Incentive Compensation may not exceed 105% of Regular Salary in the last original-term Salary Cap Year
CBA2-A10.16.basis: Extension validation covers years/first-year-max/raises only; no §8(e)(2) extend-and-trade branch and no §7(a) eligibility/anniversary/timing rules.

CBA2-A10.17.group_title: Extension-and-trade — Are the VII §8(e)(2) mechanism, window, term, salary, raise, ordinary-extension eligibility, and six-month restrictions enforced?
CBA2-A10.17.requirement: First-year incentive eligibility: a VII §8(e)(2) Extension may carry first-extended-year Incentive Compensation under the §7(a)(3)(iii) carry-forward branches only when the last original-term Salary Cap Year provides Incentive Compensation
CBA2-A10.17.basis: Extension validation covers years/first-year-max/raises only; no §8(e)(2) extend-and-trade branch and no §7(a) eligibility/anniversary/timing rules.

CBA2-A10.18.group_title: Extension-and-trade — Are the VII §8(e)(2) mechanism, window, term, salary, raise, ordinary-extension eligibility, and six-month restrictions enforced?
CBA2-A10.18.requirement: Pre-2024-25 first-year Likely Bonus ceiling: when CBA2-A10.17 is satisfied for a VII §8(e)(2) Extension signed before the first day of the 2024-25 Salary Cap Year, first-extended-year Likely Bonuses may not exceed 105% of the Likely Bonuses in the last original-term Salary Cap Year
CBA2-A10.18.basis: Extension validation covers years/first-year-max/raises only; no §8(e)(2) extend-and-trade branch and no §7(a) eligibility/anniversary/timing rules.

CBA2-A10.19.group_title: Extension-and-trade — Are the VII §8(e)(2) mechanism, window, term, salary, raise, ordinary-extension eligibility, and six-month restrictions enforced?
CBA2-A10.19.requirement: Pre-2024-25 first-year Unlikely Bonus ceiling: when CBA2-A10.17 is satisfied for a VII §8(e)(2) Extension signed before the first day of the 2024-25 Salary Cap Year, first-extended-year Unlikely Bonuses may not exceed 105% of the Unlikely Bonuses in the last original-term Salary Cap Year
CBA2-A10.19.basis: Extension validation covers years/first-year-max/raises only; no §8(e)(2) extend-and-trade branch and no §7(a) eligibility/anniversary/timing rules.

CBA2-A10.20.group_title: Extension-and-trade — Are the VII §8(e)(2) mechanism, window, term, salary, raise, ordinary-extension eligibility, and six-month restrictions enforced?
CBA2-A10.20.requirement: On/after-2024-25 first-year Unlikely Bonus ceiling: when CBA2-A10.17 is satisfied for a VII §8(e)(2) Extension signed on or after the first day of the 2024-25 Salary Cap Year, first-extended-year Unlikely Bonuses may not exceed 120% of the Unlikely Bonuses in the last original-term Salary Cap Year
CBA2-A10.20.basis: Extension validation covers years/first-year-max/raises only; no §8(e)(2) extend-and-trade branch and no §7(a) eligibility/anniversary/timing rules.

CBA2-A10.21.requirement: One- or two-Season Contract extension bar: a non-Rookie Scale Contract covering one or two Seasons, including Option Years, may not be extended under VII §7(a)
CBA2-A10.21.basis: Extension validation covers years/first-year-max/raises only; no §8(e)(2) extend-and-trade branch and no §7(a) eligibility/anniversary/timing rules.

CBA2-A10.22.requirement: Five- or six-Season Contract anniversary: a non-Rookie Scale Contract covering five or six Seasons, including Option Years, may be extended no sooner than the third anniversary of its signing or most recent Extension, as determined under CBA2-A10.26 and A10.27
CBA2-A10.22.basis: Extension validation covers years/first-year-max/raises only; no §8(e)(2) extend-and-trade branch and no §7(a) eligibility/anniversary/timing rules.

CBA2-A10.23.requirement: More-than-one-year-early off-season restriction: other than a Designated Veteran Player Extension, a VII §7(a) Extension sought more than one year before the July 1 preceding the first extended-term Season may be negotiated and entered only from July 1 through the day before the first day of the Regular Season
CBA2-A10.23.basis: Extension validation covers years/first-year-max/raises only; no §8(e)(2) extend-and-trade branch and no §7(a) eligibility/anniversary/timing rules.

CBA2-A10.24.group_title: Extension-and-trade — Are the VII §8(e)(2) mechanism, window, term, salary, raise, ordinary-extension eligibility, and six-month restrictions enforced?
CBA2-A10.24.requirement: Designated Veteran third-anniversary condition: a Designated Veteran Player Extension may be entered no sooner than the third anniversary of the Contract's signing
CBA2-A10.24.basis: Extension validation covers years/first-year-max/raises only; no §8(e)(2) extend-and-trade branch and no §7(a) eligibility/anniversary/timing rules.

CBA2-A10.26.requirement: October anniversary-date deeming: for a VII §7 anniversary, an Extension or Renegotiation entered from October 2 through the day before the first day of that Salary Cap Year's Regular Season is deemed signed on October 1 of that Salary Cap Year

CBA2-A10.27.requirement: Previously extended Contract term count: for VII §7(a)(1), the number of Seasons covered by a previously extended Contract is the number covered by its most recent Extension

CBA2-A10.28.basis: Extension validation covers years/first-year-max/raises only; no §8(e)(2) extend-and-trade branch and no §7(a) eligibility/anniversary/timing rules.

CBA2-A10.30.group_title: Extension-and-trade — Are the VII §8(e)(2) mechanism, window, term, salary, raise, ordinary-extension eligibility, and six-month restrictions enforced?
CBA2-A10.30.requirement: Simultaneous Option-action permission: a Team and player may amend a Contract simultaneously to exercise or not exercise an Option, as applicable, and enter the otherwise-permitted Extension
CBA2-A10.30.basis: Extension validation covers years/first-year-max/raises only; no §8(e)(2) extend-and-trade branch and no §7(a) eligibility/anniversary/timing rules.

CBA2-A11.1.group_title: Per-team component decomposition — Is each team's side of a multi-player transaction evaluated separately with legal component-trade decomposition?
CBA2-A11.1.requirement: Per-team component decomposition: each Team's side of a multi-player transaction is evaluated separately, and a multi-player transaction may be decomposed into CBA-permitted component trades in which each Exception replaces its own defined Traded Player(s) with its own Replacement Player(s); the validator must find a legal decomposition or report that none exists
CBA2-A11.1.basis: Each team is validated separately, but no exception-to-player decomposition search exists, so 'no legal decomposition' can never be reported.

CBA2-A12.1.group_title: Pick-trading legality — Are pick-conveyance validity, the Stepien rule, the Second Apron frozen-pick rules, and Trade Call/Memorandum disclosure consequences enforced?
CBA2-A12.1.requirement: Pick ownership: a trade may convey only a draft choice or selection right the conveying Member then owns, including a conditionally owned right; an expected future acquisition is not an owned right
CBA2-A12.1.basis: validateStepien.ts (524 lines) plus a large pick/entitlement/conveyance surface exist; frozen-pick rules depend on the missing apron history.

CBA2-A12.2.group_title: Pick-trading legality — Are pick-conveyance validity, the Stepien rule, the Second Apron frozen-pick rules, and Trade Call/Memorandum disclosure consequences enforced?
CBA2-A12.2.requirement: No cash sale of a first: no Member may sell its rights to select a player in the first round of any NBA Draft for cash or its equivalent (BYL 7.03)
CBA2-A12.2.basis: validateStepien.ts (524 lines) plus a large pick/entitlement/conveyance surface exist; frozen-pick rules depend on the missing apron history.

CBA2-A12.3.group_title: Pick-trading legality — Are pick-conveyance validity, the Stepien rule, the Second Apron frozen-pick rules, and Trade Call/Memorandum disclosure consequences enforced?
CBA2-A12.3.requirement: Stepien test: no Member may trade or exchange its right to select in the first round of any NBA Draft if the result MAY leave it without first-round picks in any two consecutive future NBA Drafts; because the test is 'may', every possible protection and conveyance branch must be evaluated, and another team's owned first-round pick can satisfy possession for a covered draft
CBA2-A12.3.basis: validateStepien.ts is a 524-line all-branch evaluator — the strongest single rule implementation found — but it depends on the pick ledger for protection branches and does not consult frozen-pick state.

CBA2-A12.4.group_title: Pick-trading legality — Are pick-conveyance validity, the Stepien rule, the Second Apron frozen-pick rules, and Trade Call/Memorandum disclosure consequences enforced?
CBA2-A12.4.requirement: Frozen-pick trading bar: if a Team is a Second Apron Team for a Salary Cap Year (Apron Team Salary above the Second Apron Level as of the start of its last Regular Season game in that year), the Team is prohibited from trading, conditionally or unconditionally, its first-round pick in the first NBA Draft following the seventh Season after the Season in that Salary Cap Year
CBA2-A12.4.basis: validateStepien.ts (524 lines) plus a large pick/entitlement/conveyance surface exist; frozen-pick rules depend on the missing apron history.

CBA2-A12.5.group_title: Pick-trading legality — Are pick-conveyance validity, the Stepien rule, the Second Apron frozen-pick rules, and Trade Call/Memorandum disclosure consequences enforced?
CBA2-A12.5.requirement: Frozen-pick unfreeze timing: when a Team is a Second Apron Team in fewer than two of the four following Salary Cap Years, the frozen first-round pick becomes tradable on the day after the Regular Season ends in the third of those years in which it is not a Second Apron Team
CBA2-A12.5.basis: validateStepien.ts (524 lines) plus a large pick/entitlement/conveyance surface exist; frozen-pick rules depend on the missing apron history.

CBA2-A12.6.group_title: Pick-trading legality — Are pick-conveyance validity, the Stepien rule, the Second Apron frozen-pick rules, and Trade Call/Memorandum disclosure consequences enforced?
CBA2-A12.6.requirement: Trade Call draft-choice disclosure: during the Trade Call, the parties must state every term and condition concerning a draft choice conveyed in the trade
CBA2-A12.6.basis: validateStepien.ts (524 lines) plus a large pick/entitlement/conveyance surface exist; frozen-pick rules depend on the missing apron history.

CBA2-A12.7.group_title: Pick-trading legality — Are pick-conveyance validity, the Stepien rule, the Second Apron frozen-pick rules, and Trade Call/Memorandum disclosure consequences enforced?
CBA2-A12.7.requirement: No Draft Pick Penalty after unfreeze: a frozen first-round pick released under VII §2(f)(2)(ii)(B) is not subject to a Draft Pick Penalty
CBA2-A12.7.basis: validateStepien.ts (524 lines) plus a large pick/entitlement/conveyance surface exist; frozen-pick rules depend on the missing apron history.

CBA2-A12.8.group_title: Pick-trading legality — Are pick-conveyance validity, the Stepien rule, the Second Apron frozen-pick rules, and Trade Call/Memorandum disclosure consequences enforced?
CBA2-A12.8.requirement: Trade Memorandum draft-choice record: every term and condition concerning a draft choice conveyed in a trade must be included in the Trade Memorandum
CBA2-A12.8.basis: validateStepien.ts (524 lines) plus a large pick/entitlement/conveyance surface exist; frozen-pick rules depend on the missing apron history.

CBA2-A12.9.group_title: Pick-trading legality — Are pick-conveyance validity, the Stepien rule, the Second Apron frozen-pick rules, and Trade Call/Memorandum disclosure consequences enforced?
CBA2-A12.9.requirement: Undisclosed draft-choice term unenforceability: a draft-choice term or condition that the parties do not disclose to the Association Office during the Trade Call is unenforceable
CBA2-A12.9.basis: validateStepien.ts (524 lines) plus a large pick/entitlement/conveyance surface exist; frozen-pick rules depend on the missing apron history.

CBA2-C01.1.group_title: Team Salary and Free Agent Amounts — Are roster salary, free-agent holds, multipliers, bounds, and RFA/unrenounce branches computed from the signed definitions?

CBA2-C01.1.basis: calculateCapHold implements 190/130/120 but omits the EAPS-conditional 150% and the 300/250% rookie-scale-fourth-year branches, the min/max bounds, and the RFA greatest-of.

CBA2-C01.2.group_title: Team Salary and Free Agent Amounts — Are roster salary, free-agent holds, multipliers, bounds, and RFA/unrenounce branches computed from the signed definitions?
CBA2-C01.2.requirement: Veteran-free-agent inclusion: Team Salary includes the applicable Free Agent Amount for each Veteran Free Agent who last played for the Team and remains unrenounced and unsigned
CBA2-C01.2.basis: calculateCapHold implements 190/130/120 but omits the EAPS-conditional 150% and the 300/250% rookie-scale-fourth-year branches, the min/max bounds, and the RFA greatest-of.

CBA2-C01.3.group_title: Team Salary and Free Agent Amounts — Are roster salary, free-agent holds, multipliers, bounds, and RFA/unrenounce branches computed from the signed definitions?
CBA2-C01.3.requirement: QVFA calculation base: the ordinary Qualifying Veteran Free Agent Amount starts from the player's prior Regular Salary plus the prior-year signing-bonus allocation and Performance Bonuses actually earned
CBA2-C01.3.basis: calculateCapHold implements 190/130/120 but omits the EAPS-conditional 150% and the 300/250% rookie-scale-fourth-year branches, the min/max bounds, and the RFA greatest-of.

CBA2-C01.4.group_title: Team Salary and Free Agent Amounts — Are roster salary, free-agent holds, multipliers, bounds, and RFA/unrenounce branches computed from the signed definitions?
CBA2-C01.4.requirement: QVFA multiplier table: subject to the applicable minimum and maximum, a Rookie Scale fourth-year free agent uses 300% below EAPS or 250% at/above EAPS; another QVFA uses 190% below EAPS or 150% at/above EAPS; an Early QVFA uses 130%; and a Non-QVFA uses 120%
CBA2-C01.4.basis: capHolds.ts:137-143 encodes 190/130/120 only. The EAPS-conditional 150% branch for a QVFA at or above the Estimated Average Player Salary and the entire 300%/250% rookie-scale-fourth-year branch are missing, so post-rookie stars' holds are understated.

CBA2-C01.5.group_title: Team Salary and Free Agent Amounts — Are roster salary, free-agent holds, multipliers, bounds, and RFA/unrenounce branches computed from the signed definitions?
CBA2-C01.5.requirement: Prior-Minimum FA amount: a Veteran Free Agent whose prior Contract was a one-Season Minimum Player Salary Contract has a Free Agent Amount equal to the Minimum Player Salary then applicable to that player, capped at the two-YOS minimum
CBA2-C01.5.basis: calculateCapHold implements 190/130/120 but omits the EAPS-conditional 150% and the 300/250% rookie-scale-fourth-year branches, the min/max bounds, and the RFA greatest-of.

CBA2-C01.6.group_title: Team Salary and Free Agent Amounts — Are roster salary, free-agent holds, multipliers, bounds, and RFA/unrenounce branches computed from the signed definitions?
CBA2-C01.6.requirement: Free Agent Amount bounds: the calculated Free Agent Amount may not be less than the player's applicable Minimum Player Salary or greater than his applicable Maximum Annual Salary
CBA2-C01.6.basis: calculateCapHold never clamps the result to the applicable minimum or maximum annual salary.

CBA2-C01.7.group_title: Team Salary and Free Agent Amounts — Are roster salary, free-agent holds, multipliers, bounds, and RFA/unrenounce branches computed from the signed definitions?
CBA2-C01.7.requirement: RFA amount: a Restricted Free Agent's Team Salary amount is the greatest of his applicable Free Agent Amount, outstanding Qualifying Offer or Maximum Qualifying Offer amount, and First Refusal Exercise Notice amount, as applicable
CBA2-C01.7.basis: calculateCapHold implements 190/130/120 but omits the EAPS-conditional 150% and the 300/250% rookie-scale-fourth-year branches, the min/max bounds, and the RFA greatest-of.

CBA2-C01.8.group_title: Team Salary and Free Agent Amounts — Are roster salary, free-agent holds, multipliers, bounds, and RFA/unrenounce branches computed from the signed definitions?
CBA2-C01.8.requirement: Veteran-free-agent removal: the applicable Free Agent Amount ceases to be included when the player signs, the Team renounces him, or another signed-text event ends the Team's applicable free-agent treatment
CBA2-C01.8.basis: calculateCapHold implements 190/130/120 but omits the EAPS-conditional 150% and the 300/250% rookie-scale-fourth-year branches, the min/max bounds, and the RFA greatest-of.

CBA2-C01.9.group_title: Team Salary and Free Agent Amounts — Are roster salary, free-agent holds, multipliers, bounds, and RFA/unrenounce branches computed from the signed definitions?
CBA2-C01.9.requirement: Matched-offer-sheet unrenounce: a Team that renounced player(s) solely to create Room for an Offer Sheet that was matched may rescind the renunciation(s) within two business days, subject to the two VII §4(g)(1) Team Salary ceilings
CBA2-C01.9.basis: calculateCapHold implements 190/130/120 but omits the EAPS-conditional 150% and the 300/250% rookie-scale-fourth-year branches, the min/max bounds, and the RFA greatest-of.

CBA2-C02.3.group_title: Unsigned first-round-pick amounts — Is the 120% Rookie Scale Amount included and removed/restored only on the signed lifecycle events?

CBA2-C03.1.group_title: Incomplete-roster charges — Are the offseason count, twelve-player threshold, and zero-YOS charge applied only in the signed window?
CBA2-C03.1.requirement: Incomplete-roster count: solely for VII §4(f), count under-contract players included in Team Salary, Veteran Free Agents included in Team Salary, players given Offer Sheets, and unsigned First Round Picks included in Team Salary
CBA2-C03.1.basis: computeTeamCapTotals.ts:268 counts standard-roster players only; the rule's count also includes Veteran Free Agents in Team Salary, players given Offer Sheets and unsigned First Round Picks.

CBA2-C03.2.group_title: Incomplete-roster charges — Are the offseason count, twelve-player threshold, and zero-YOS charge applied only in the signed window?
CBA2-C03.2.requirement: Incomplete-roster charge: from July 1 through the day before the Regular Season, if the CBA2-C03.1 count is below twelve, Team Salary includes one zero-YOS Minimum Player Salary for each missing player
CBA2-C03.2.basis: computeTeamCapTotals.ts:270-272 charges below 14 (rules.roster.minStandard) rather than 12, and applies the charge in every season phase; the rule is confined to July 1 through the day before the Regular Season.

CBA2-C04.1.group_title: Exception amounts in Team Salary — Are available exception amounts included, reduced, and removed under VII §6(n)?
CBA2-C04.1.requirement: Exception availability threshold: a Team may use the DPE, BAE, NTMLE, TMLE, or TPE only if Team Salary is at or above the Salary Cap or below it by less than the available exception amount, subject to the specific exception's other conditions
CBA2-C04.1.basis: faExceptionBuckets exist with used/remaining, but exception amounts are not included in Team Salary under §6(n) and are not renounceable there.

CBA2-C04.2.group_title: Exception amounts in Team Salary — Are available exception amounts included, reduced, and removed under VII §6(n)?

CBA2-C05.2.basis: contractUtils.ts:449 substitutes a minimum cap hit for 3+ YOS minimum players; League reimbursement and its dead-salary consequence are not modelled.

CBA2-C05.3.basis: contractUtils.ts:449 substitutes a minimum cap hit for 3+ YOS minimum players; League reimbursement and its dead-salary consequence are not modelled.

CBA2-C05.4.group_title: Minimum-contract reimbursement — Are contract eligibility, Team Salary treatment, League reimbursement, and dead-salary treatment kept distinct?

CBA2-C05.5.group_title: Minimum-contract reimbursement — Are contract eligibility, Team Salary treatment, League reimbursement, and dead-salary treatment kept distinct?
CBA2-C05.5.requirement: Minimum-exception/reimbursement independence: eligibility to sign or acquire a player with the Minimum Player Salary Exception and eligibility for League reimbursement are separate signed tests
CBA2-C05.5.basis: contractUtils.ts:449 substitutes a minimum cap hit for 3+ YOS minimum players; League reimbursement and its dead-salary consequence are not modelled.

CBA2-C09.1.group_title: Tax rates and brackets — Are standard/repeater status, bracket sizing, transition years, and progressive tax computed from VII §2(d)?
CBA2-C09.1.requirement: Tax Bracket Amount: for a Salary Cap Year, the amount equals $5 million multiplied by the Salary Cap for that year and divided by the Salary Cap for 2023-24
CBA2-C09.1.basis: No tax rate, bracket, repeater or progressive computation. No V1 workflow requires a tax bill, so severity is low despite total absence.

CBA2-C09.2.group_title: Tax rates and brackets — Are standard/repeater status, bracket sizing, transition years, and progressive tax computed from VII §2(d)?
CBA2-C09.2.requirement: Standard tax rates: beginning in 2025-26, the first four bracket rates for a non-repeater taxpayer are 1.00, 1.25, 3.50, and 4.75 dollars per tax dollar
CBA2-C09.2.basis: No tax rate, bracket, repeater or progressive computation. No V1 workflow requires a tax bill, so severity is low despite total absence.

CBA2-C09.3.group_title: Tax rates and brackets — Are standard/repeater status, bracket sizing, transition years, and progressive tax computed from VII §2(d)?
CBA2-C09.3.requirement: Repeater status: a current taxpayer is a repeater when it was a taxpayer in at least three of the four immediately preceding Salary Cap Years
CBA2-C09.3.basis: No tax rate, bracket, repeater or progressive computation. No V1 workflow requires a tax bill, so severity is low despite total absence.

CBA2-C09.4.group_title: Tax rates and brackets — Are standard/repeater status, bracket sizing, transition years, and progressive tax computed from VII §2(d)?
CBA2-C09.4.requirement: Repeater tax rates: beginning in 2025-26, the first four bracket rates for a repeater taxpayer are 3.00, 3.25, 5.50, and 6.75 dollars per tax dollar
CBA2-C09.4.basis: No tax rate, bracket, repeater or progressive computation. No V1 workflow requires a tax bill, so severity is low despite total absence.

CBA2-C09.5.group_title: Tax rates and brackets — Are standard/repeater status, bracket sizing, transition years, and progressive tax computed from VII §2(d)?
CBA2-C09.5.requirement: Additional tax brackets: each bracket beyond the fourth increases the applicable preceding bracket rate by $0.50
CBA2-C09.5.basis: No tax rate, bracket, repeater or progressive computation. No V1 workflow requires a tax bill, so severity is low despite total absence.

CBA2-C09.6.group_title: Tax rates and brackets — Are standard/repeater status, bracket sizing, transition years, and progressive tax computed from VII §2(d)?
CBA2-C09.6.requirement: Tax transition years: 2023-24 and 2024-25 use the legacy bracket amount and tax-rate rules expressly preserved by VII §2(d) rather than the 2025-26 schedule
CBA2-C09.6.basis: No tax rate, bracket, repeater or progressive computation. No V1 workflow requires a tax bill, so severity is low despite total absence.

CBA2-C09.7.group_title: Tax rates and brackets — Are standard/repeater status, bracket sizing, transition years, and progressive tax computed from VII §2(d)?
CBA2-C09.7.requirement: Progressive tax calculation: tax equals the sum of each fully traversed bracket plus the partial amount in the final bracket at that bracket's applicable rate
CBA2-C09.7.basis: No tax rate, bracket, repeater or progressive computation. No V1 workflow requires a tax bill, so severity is low despite total absence.

CBA2-C10.1.group_title: Minimum Team Salary — Are the amount, three adjusted bases, payment, charge, restoration, audit timing, and distribution consequences kept distinct?
CBA2-C10.1.requirement: Minimum Team Salary amount: the Minimum Team Salary for a Salary Cap Year is 90% of the Salary Cap for that year
CBA2-C10.1.basis: The 90% floor value is carried (capProjections.floor, ruleContext.minimumTeamSalary) but no shortfall charge, payment, restoration or audit process exists.

CBA2-C10.2.group_title: Minimum Team Salary — Are the amount, three adjusted bases, payment, charge, restoration, audit timing, and distribution consequences kept distinct?
CBA2-C10.2.requirement: MTS Cap Hold Team Salary: calculate Team Salary in the same manner the Accountants calculate Team Salary for Total Salaries and Benefits in the Audit Report
CBA2-C10.2.basis: The 90% floor value is carried (capProjections.floor, ruleContext.minimumTeamSalary) but no shortfall charge, payment, restoration or audit process exists.

CBA2-C10.3.group_title: Minimum Team Salary — Are the amount, three adjusted bases, payment, charge, restoration, audit timing, and distribution consequences kept distinct?
CBA2-C10.3.requirement: MTS Payment Team Salary: take MTS Cap Hold Team Salary at the start of the first Regular Season day, add §4(h)-excluded Salary, subtract §3(e)-included Salary, and add §4(b)-excluded Salary for the Salary Cap Year
CBA2-C10.3.basis: The 90% floor value is carried (capProjections.floor, ruleContext.minimumTeamSalary) but no shortfall charge, payment, restoration or audit process exists.

CBA2-C10.4.group_title: Minimum Team Salary — Are the amount, three adjusted bases, payment, charge, restoration, audit timing, and distribution consequences kept distinct?
CBA2-C10.4.requirement: MTS Threshold: determine the CBA's start-of-Regular-Season threshold from the separate MTS Threshold Team Salary calculation
CBA2-C10.4.basis: The 90% floor value is carried (capProjections.floor, ruleContext.minimumTeamSalary) but no shortfall charge, payment, restoration or audit process exists.

CBA2-C10.5.group_title: Minimum Team Salary — Are the amount, three adjusted bases, payment, charge, restoration, audit timing, and distribution consequences kept distinct?
CBA2-C10.5.requirement: MTS Team Salary charge: from the start of the first Regular Season day through the end of the Salary Cap Year, Team Salary includes the amount by which the Minimum Team Salary exceeds the lesser of current MTS Cap Hold Team Salary and its value at the start of that first day
CBA2-C10.5.basis: The 90% floor value is carried (capProjections.floor, ruleContext.minimumTeamSalary) but no shortfall charge, payment, restoration or audit process exists.

CBA2-C10.6.group_title: Minimum Team Salary — Are the amount, three adjusted bases, payment, charge, restoration, audit timing, and distribution consequences kept distinct?
CBA2-C10.6.requirement: Next-day MTS restoration duty: if MTS Cap Hold Team Salary decreases below the MTS Threshold on a Regular Season day, the Team must increase it to at least the threshold by the end of the immediately following day
CBA2-C10.6.basis: The 90% floor value is carried (capProjections.floor, ruleContext.minimumTeamSalary) but no shortfall charge, payment, restoration or audit process exists.

CBA2-C10.7.group_title: Minimum Team Salary — Are the amount, three adjusted bases, payment, charge, restoration, audit timing, and distribution consequences kept distinct?
CBA2-C10.7.requirement: Initial MTS shortfall payment: when MTS Payment Team Salary is below the Minimum Team Salary, the Team must pay the NBA the difference
CBA2-C10.7.basis: The 90% floor value is carried (capProjections.floor, ruleContext.minimumTeamSalary) but no shortfall charge, payment, restoration or audit process exists.

CBA2-C10.8.group_title: Minimum Team Salary — Are the amount, three adjusted bases, payment, charge, restoration, audit timing, and distribution consequences kept distinct?
CBA2-C10.8.requirement: MTS tax-distribution consequence: an MTS-payment Team is ineligible for the non-taxpayer distribution under VII §2(d)(4); for 2023-24 only, a non-tax-owing MTS-payment Team instead received 50% of its otherwise applicable share
CBA2-C10.8.basis: The 90% floor value is carried (capProjections.floor, ruleContext.minimumTeamSalary) but no shortfall charge, payment, restoration or audit process exists.

CBA2-C10.9.group_title: Minimum Team Salary — Are the amount, three adjusted bases, payment, charge, restoration, audit timing, and distribution consequences kept distinct?
CBA2-C10.9.requirement: Year-end additional MTS payment: if the Minimum Team Salary exceeds the Team's financially responsible total MTS Cap Hold Team Salaries, adjusted for actually earned and unearned Incentive Compensation as §2(c)(5) specifies, plus its CBA2-C10.7 payment, the Team pays the NBA that excess
CBA2-C10.9.basis: The 90% floor value is carried (capProjections.floor, ruleContext.minimumTeamSalary) but no shortfall charge, payment, restoration or audit process exists.

CBA2-C10.10.group_title: Minimum Team Salary — Are the amount, three adjusted bases, payment, charge, restoration, audit timing, and distribution consequences kept distinct?
CBA2-C10.10.requirement: MTS team-payment timing: each payment due under CBA2-C10.7 or CBA2-C10.9 must be made to the NBA no later than ten business days after completion of the Governing Audit Report for the Salary Cap Year
CBA2-C10.10.basis: The 90% floor value is carried (capProjections.floor, ruleContext.minimumTeamSalary) but no shortfall charge, payment, restoration or audit process exists.

CBA2-C10.11.group_title: Minimum Team Salary — Are the amount, three adjusted bases, payment, charge, restoration, audit timing, and distribution consequences kept distinct?
CBA2-C10.11.requirement: MTS distribution timing: the NBA must distribute payments received under CBA2-C10.10 equally to each Team within ten business days after receipt
CBA2-C10.11.basis: The 90% floor value is carried (capProjections.floor, ruleContext.minimumTeamSalary) but no shortfall charge, payment, restoration or audit process exists.

CBA2-C18.1.group_title: Signing and Extension bonuses — Are ordinary, trade-earned, and Extension bonuses allocated under the correct timing and protection branches?
CBA2-C18.1.requirement: An ordinary signing bonus is allocated among Salary Cap Years in proportion to Base Compensation protected for lack of skill
CBA2-C18.1.basis: No signing-bonus representation or proportional-guarantee allocation; only a scalar tradeBonus field.

CBA2-C18.2.group_title: Signing and Extension bonuses — Are ordinary, trade-earned, and Extension bonuses allocated under the correct timing and protection branches?
CBA2-C18.2.requirement: An ETO Season is excluded from ordinary signing-bonus allocation
CBA2-C18.2.basis: No signing-bonus representation or proportional-guarantee allocation; only a scalar tradeBonus field.

CBA2-C18.3.group_title: Signing and Extension bonuses — Are ordinary, trade-earned, and Extension bonuses allocated under the correct timing and protection branches?
CBA2-C18.3.requirement: If no future Season has protected Base Compensation, the unallocated ordinary signing bonus is attributed to the first Salary Cap Year
CBA2-C18.3.basis: No signing-bonus representation or proportional-guarantee allocation; only a scalar tradeBonus field.

CBA2-C18.4.group_title: Signing and Extension bonuses — Are ordinary, trade-earned, and Extension bonuses allocated under the correct timing and protection branches?
CBA2-C18.4.requirement: A trade bonus earned during a Contract is allocated only to the current and remaining Salary Cap Years under protected-percentage rules
CBA2-C18.4.basis: No signing-bonus representation or proportional-guarantee allocation; only a scalar tradeBonus field.

CBA2-C18.5.group_title: Signing and Extension bonuses — Are ordinary, trade-earned, and Extension bonuses allocated under the correct timing and protection branches?
CBA2-C18.5.requirement: If Team Salary is at or above the Salary Cap when an Extension is signed, an Extension signing bonus may be paid no sooner than the first day of the first extended Salary Cap Year
CBA2-C18.5.basis: No signing-bonus representation or proportional-guarantee allocation; only a scalar tradeBonus field.

CBA2-C18.6.group_title: Signing and Extension bonuses — Are ordinary, trade-earned, and Extension bonuses allocated under the correct timing and protection branches?
CBA2-C18.6.requirement: If no extended Season has protected Base Compensation in that branch, the bonus is attributed to the first extended Salary Cap Year
CBA2-C18.6.basis: No signing-bonus representation or proportional-guarantee allocation; only a scalar tradeBonus field.

CBA2-C18.7.group_title: Signing and Extension bonuses — Are ordinary, trade-earned, and Extension bonuses allocated under the correct timing and protection branches?
CBA2-C18.7.requirement: A below-cap Extension bonus paid on or after the first extended Salary Cap Year uses the same extended-term-only allocation and fallback
CBA2-C18.7.basis: No signing-bonus representation or proportional-guarantee allocation; only a scalar tradeBonus field.

CBA2-C18.8.group_title: Signing and Extension bonuses — Are ordinary, trade-earned, and Extension bonuses allocated under the correct timing and protection branches?
CBA2-C18.8.requirement: A below-cap Extension bonus paid before the first extended Salary Cap Year is allocated over the then-current signing year, remaining original years, and extended years by protected Base Compensation; if none is protected, the entire bonus is allocated to the signing year
CBA2-C18.8.basis: No signing-bonus representation or proportional-guarantee allocation; only a scalar tradeBonus field.

CBA2-C18.9.group_title: Signing and Extension bonuses — Are ordinary, trade-earned, and Extension bonuses allocated under the correct timing and protection branches?
CBA2-C18.9.requirement: A below-cap early-paid Extension bonus is deemed a Renegotiation for Salary Cap purposes
CBA2-C18.9.basis: No signing-bonus representation or proportional-guarantee allocation; only a scalar tradeBonus field.

CBA2-C18.10.group_title: Signing and Extension bonuses — Are ordinary, trade-earned, and Extension bonuses allocated under the correct timing and protection branches?
CBA2-C18.10.requirement: A below-cap early-paid Extension bonus must be paid in two installments: the portion allocated to original Contract years before the first extended Salary Cap Year, and the portion allocated to extended years on or after the first day of the first extended Salary Cap Year
CBA2-C18.10.basis: No signing-bonus representation or proportional-guarantee allocation; only a scalar tradeBonus field.

CBA2-C18.11.group_title: Signing and Extension bonuses — Are ordinary, trade-earned, and Extension bonuses allocated under the correct timing and protection branches?
CBA2-C18.11.requirement: If an Extension removes the original trade-bonus provision, a previously earned trade bonus remains allocated over the original term only
CBA2-C18.11.basis: No signing-bonus representation or proportional-guarantee allocation; only a scalar tradeBonus field.

CBA2-C18.12.group_title: Signing and Extension bonuses — Are ordinary, trade-earned, and Extension bonuses allocated under the correct timing and protection branches?
CBA2-C18.12.requirement: For a retained trade bonus earned before the extended term, the calculation uses contractual extended-term Base Compensation, the signed 4.5% Salary Cap growth assumption where required, and the stated deemed-maximum amendment calculation
CBA2-C18.12.basis: No signing-bonus representation or proportional-guarantee allocation; only a scalar tradeBonus field.

CBA2-C18.13.group_title: Signing and Extension bonuses — Are ordinary, trade-earned, and Extension bonuses allocated under the correct timing and protection branches?
CBA2-C18.13.requirement: General signing-bonus allocation requires the protected-percentage basis, ETO exclusion, zero-protection fallback, and trade-earned remaining-year boundary
CBA2-C18.13.basis: No signing-bonus representation or proportional-guarantee allocation; only a scalar tradeBonus field.
